description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את תהליך החלפת רכב המבוטח בפוליסת ביטוח רכב. במקרה של החלפת רכב, ניתן להעביר את הכיסוי הביטוחי לרכב חלופי באישור המבטח. אם דמי הביטוח עבור הרכב החלופי גבוהים יותר, המבוטח ישלם את ההפרש באופן יחסי לתקופה הנותרת. אם דמי הביטוח עבור הרכב החלופי נמוכים יותר, המבטח יחזיר את ההפרש באופן יחסי. טבלה זו רלוונטית לפוליסת ביטוח רכב פרטי ומסחרי עד 35 טון. החלפת רכב, רכב חלופי, דמי ביטוח, תקופה יתרה.

44. Replacement of the vehicle
44.1 In the event that the insured replaces the vehicle in the course of the insurance period and purchases an alternative vehicle, the insured may, after providing a notice to the insurer and after obtaining its consent, transfer the cover under this policy to the alternative vehicle.
44.2 If, on the date of replacement, the insurance fees for the replaced vehicle are lower than the insurance fees for the alternative vehicle, the insured shall pay the difference to the insurer, pro-rata to the remaining insurance period, within 30 days after the replacement date.
44.3 If, on the date of replacement, the insurance fees for the replaced vehicle are higher than the insurance fees for the alternative vehicle, the insurer shall pay the difference to the insured, pro-rata to the remaining insurance period, within 30 days after the replacement date.
44.4 Nothing stated in sub-paragraphs 44.1, 44.2 and 44.3 shall prevent the insurer from demanding payment to cover its expenses for transferring the insurance cover in accordance with its authorized tariffs.

This table details the process and financial adjustments when a vehicle covered by a car insurance policy is replaced during the policy period. It outlines how insurance fees are adjusted pro-rata based on the remaining insurance period.
ממדים: Scenarios related to vehicle replacement, Conditions and financial adjustments

44. Replacement of the vehicle
44.1 In the event that the insured replaces the vehicle in the course of the insurance period and purchases an alternative vehicle, the insured may, after providing a notice to the insurer and after obtaining its consent, transfer the cover under this policy to the alternative vehicle.
44.2 If, on the date of replacement, the insurance fees for the replaced vehicle are lower than the insurance fees for the alternative vehicle, the insured shall pay the difference to the insurer, pro-rata to the remaining insurance period, within 30 days after the replacement date.
44.3 If, on the date of replacement, the insurance fees for the replaced vehicle are higher than the insurance fees for the alternative vehicle, the insurer shall pay the difference to the insured, pro-rata to the remaining insurance period, within 30 days after the replacement date.
44.4 Nothing stated in sub-paragraphs 44.1, 44.2 and 44.3 shall prevent the insurer from demanding payment to cover its expenses for transferring the insurance cover in accordance with its authorized tariffs.
